objectives: Distinguish an image from a container.

sections.title: Containers
sections.text: A container packages an application with the dependencies it needs and runs it in an isolated environment. Containers typically share the host operating system kernel.

sections.title: Images and Dockerfiles
sections.text: An image is a template used to create containers. A Dockerfile describes instructions for building an image.

sections.title: Volumes
sections.text: A volume stores data outside a container's writable layer, allowing data to persist when a container is replaced.
